info.name: AppConnect V3 Landing Pages Reporting API
info.description:
The Constant Contact, Inc. V3 public API, for building integrations with Constant Contact, the leading small-business email marketing platform.

Contact Support:
 Name: webservices@constantcontact.com

item.name: GET a Unique Contacts Clicks Landing Page Report

query.description: Use to limit the number of contact tracking activities to return on a single page. The default is `50` and the maximum is `500` per page.
Use to filter the results to return only contacts that match a contacts full or partial first or last name, or email. For example: Josie or Jo.

variable.description: (Required) The landing page `campaign_activity_id` (UUID's) to use to get unique contact click results.

request.description: Use this method get details about each contact that clicked a link on a landing page campaign activity. Unique contact clicks are identified by both the `contact_id` and `url_id`. The same contact may appear more than once in the results, if they clicked more than one link on the landing page. The resulting contact data is listed with most recent activity first.

response.name: Request was successful.
